data.title: IMCTC Concludes 'Peace Journalists' Program in Pakistan
data.content:
Islamabad, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The Islamic Military Counter Terrorism Coalition (IMCTC) has concluded a training program in Islamabad, Pakistan, as part of its strategic media initiative, "Peace Journalists." The program aimed to equip journalists and media professionals with the skills to analyze extremist and hate speech on digital media platforms and address such content professionally.
    Over five days, the program covered practical techniques for analyzing digital content, verifying images and videos, and identifying sources of misinformation. It enabled participants to apply these tools in producing reports based on reliable information and to better understand how extremist discourse spreads across digital platforms.
    The program is part of the coalition's ongoing efforts to build media capacity in its member states, strengthen journalism's role in countering extremist and hate rhetoric, and curb the spread of misleading content.
    -- SPA
